ltv_assumptions: One paying operator retains for one leasing cycle or roughly four months.
Average monthly retainer lands near the target price point of $900.

paid_social_meta.classification: theoretically healthy but impractical at bootstrap stage

skipped_channels: ASO organic - not an app at launch
TikTok organic - not the best path to first B2B customer
press_product_hunt - wrong format for the first offer
recommended_first_channel_rationale: The founder can build a list of Auburn operators immediately, attach one sample insight teardown, and ask for a paid pilot without spending money on ads.
viability_verdict_rationale: The first-customer path is service-sales based rather than app-growth based. At bootstrap budget, direct outreach is viable if the founder can prove local insight value quickly.
